title: Tarzan and the Ant Men
summary: "Tarzan and the Ant Men" by Edgar Rice Burroughs is a novel published in 1924. The jungle hero enters the isolated land of Minuni, where he encounters a civilization of people four times smaller than himself. Befriending their leaders, Tarzan joins their wars between rival city-states. When captured, he's reduced to Minunian size through experimental science and must navigate imprisonment, escape, and survival in a world of miniature warriors and magnificent cities.
